The connector's log lines are now level-queryable JSON in the tier's OpenObserve `modal_logs` stream (mngr-internal#656): every Modal function (the web app and each cron / spawned function) calls the shared `configure_logging()` before `init_sentry`, so each line is one JSON object with an explicit `level`, `logger`, and `timestamp` (`spath(body, 'level')`).

This also fixes a silent gap: the containers had no root log handler, so the connector's `logger.info` lines (cron completion summaries, workspace stop/start transitions, suspension actions, ...) were never emitted at all and its warnings / errors reached the logs as bare messages without a level or logger name. The entrypoint's own logger is now named `imbue.remote_service_connector.app` (Modal mounts `app.py` as module `app`, so a `__name__` logger sat outside the `imbue.*` subtree and its cron summary lines stayed dropped), and a cron that raises logs one `level: ERROR` line via `capture_and_reraise`. Our `imbue.*` loggers now emit at INFO (`MINDS_LOG_LEVEL=DEBUG` at deploy time raises a dev env); third-party libraries stay at WARNING.
